meta-description: Search and filter the skill trees — maps of how the skills and concepts in a subject build on one another, with an AI instruction for every node.
page-intro: Each tree maps one subject: what a student needs to be able to do, and what each thing builds on. Open a tree to tick off what you have mastered and copy the AI instruction for a given skill.
page-language-note: The trees themselves are not translated. Each one is written in a single language by the teacher who made it, and that language is shown on its card and in the Language filter.
search-placeholder: Subject, level, topic or keyword — e.g. “2P”, “statistics”, “growth factor”
load-error: Could not load the catalogue: {message} (are you serving this through a local server? fetch() of JSON files fails when index.html is opened straight from disk.)
empty-body: Try fewer filters or a broader search.
